    FROM expense e, latest_expense le
    WHERE e.expense_date >= DATE(le.max_date, '-12 months')
      AND e.expense_date <= le.max_date
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member

        m.member_id,
        m.first_name,
        m.last_name,

        re.total_spent

    JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
),

        first_name,
        last_name,
        department,

    FROM member_spending
)

    last_name,
    department

    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
top_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name, attendance_cnt
    FROM event_attendance
    ORDER BY attendance_cnt DESC
    LIMIT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event) + 9) / 10

WITH event_counts AS (
    SELECT e."event_id", COUNT(a."link_to_member") AS attendance_cnt
    FROM "event" e
    LEFT JOIN "attendance" a ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
    GROUP BY e."event_id"
),
median_att AS (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) AS median_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT attendance_cnt AS cnt
        FROM event_counts
        ORDER BY attendance_cnt
        LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_counts) % 2
        OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM event_counts)

)
SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN event_counts ec ON e."event_id" = ec."event_id"
JOIN median_att m ON ec.attendance_cnt > m.median_cnt;
